name: Smooth Vertex Lighting with Ambient Occlusion Effect
aliases: Mock Ambient Occlusion via Vertex Light Averaging
Smooth Ambient Occlusion / Soft Vertex Lighting
definition: A lighting calculation method for voxel meshes that computes vertex lighting by averaging light values from surrounding voxel cells to ensure smooth transitions, while naturally darkening concave areas to simulate ambient occlusion.
summary: Smooth Vertex Lighting with Ambient Occlusion Effect averages four surrounding voxel light intensities to eliminate blocky transitions, achieving ambient occlusion without ray-casting costs.
